nodes.label: Rizal Monument Town Plaza (Philippine city center)
Login Screen Local-Identity Backdrop
nodes.rationale: A landscape photo (2016x1512) of a local civic landmark, a white Rizal monument with a clock tower, allegorical statues and cannons, set in a landscaped plaza with a central walkway. Most likely used as the full-bleed background of the login page to give the transaction management system a local government / municipal identity. It is a photograph, not a UI screenshot. The open sky in the upper half leaves room for an overlaid login form.
